scope: Repair how Workspace answers read: shorter instructions that give each figure one home, no second copy of a visual on screen, list markers, one typography, calculator and chart sizing, right-to-left rhythm, a false calculator conflict, and a stable view while an answer is written.

keep: The existing answer validators, saved answer text, Copy, Share, renderer library and model route
extend: Answer instructions with one concision rule by request type
The newest exchange keeps room under its prompt while it is answered
Reading rhythm for Arabic-script and Devanagari answers
replace: A complete written backup of every visual with the existing generated plain-text copy
An always-open chart data table with one that opens on request

architecture.reason: Changes instruction text, presentation and one comparison inside the existing answer path.

egress.description: No destination or request body changes beyond the instruction text sent to the existing model.

cost.description: No extra model calls and no output limit change.

tests.scope: The saved copy of a visual is not drawn twice; unbound or different prose is left untouched.
A figure that rounds to the readout agrees; a different figure is still a conflict.
The instructions ask for concise answers and no written backup of visuals.
Script rhythm follows the dominant script and ignores a quoted word or plain numbers.

rollout: Backend and frontend together, after the parent chat release. Check real answers on a candidate before promotion.
rollback: Re-promote the previous verified backend revision and frontend build; no database changes.
knownGaps: Real model answers under the new instructions are not verified.
The turn spacer is not verified in the signed-in Workspace or on a physical phone.

blockers: Founder approval and live answer acceptance on a candidate.
